nativeConnectionUi.identifyNewEdge: Read existing fieldset[data-edge-form] IDs before adding; new edge is the ID difference, exactly one.
order: Select targetScreen first for open/navigate; target none for close/back
Set concise label and return description; leave trial itemId empty
Set condition=always LAST only for accepted candidates
After each change/Tab, reacquire current fieldset/field because UI rerenders
Save, reopen, and test actual source page→input→target→close/back→focus return
nativeConnectionUi.defaults: New edge click/feedback/unknown, label 새 행동, payload.message 시험 안내, returnPolicy 미정. No arbitrary payload JSON editor.
semantics: Setting navigate/open without a target normalizes condition to unknown.
unknown stops execution; first true outgoing edge wins.
navigate pushes history and clears overlays; back pops history.
open pushes another overlay; close removes that overlay and restores its trigger focus, so Menu→Mail/Friends can return to Menu.
returnPolicy is stored descriptive metadata here; runtime return is implemented by history/overlay stack, not parsing its text.
Selecting a caption creates a caption source edge. Use the mapped input root IDs.
